messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a customer dashboard showing negative provisional token credits after a streaming reconnect + retry. Seen it twice for the same org.
ben: huh. negative provisional? do you have a screenshot?
maria: pasted — Console -> Billing -> Customer ABC -> provisional delta shows -18 tokens for two sessions. (screenshot)
alyssa: could be sampling window vs ledger commit timing. we sample telemetry at 100ms and reconcile ledger in batches at 30s, right?
devon: yep. sampling can double-count truncated suffixes on reconnect if retry emits snapshot + resumed stream.
maria: exact sequence I saw: client reconnects, server emits prefix A (credited), stream reconnects and server emits prefix A again in the resumed chunk, then toolcall truncates suffix B earlier. Sampling logged A twice but ledger dedupe removed the duplicate later — console provisional stayed negative once ledger corrected.
ben: so provisional = sample-derived estimate, confirmed = ledger. Negative provisional comes when ledger subtracts previously tentative credits that sampling still shows as pending?
alayssa: in this case provisional is computed from cumulative sampling+prefetch estimator. when we apply a heuristic to subtract truncated toolcall tokens, it can overshoot because sampling latency caused stale counts.
ops-bot: ALERT: billing-provisional-smoothing job flagged 2 anomalies for customer ABC (ids: sess-1123, sess-1124).
sam: can you paste the sampling logs and ledger entries for sess-1123? I want to see timestamps around the reconnect.
maria: here are clipped logs:
```
[12:01:03.123] sample: sess-1123 prefix=40 toolcall=0 suffix=8
[12:01:03.310] stream: reconnect detected, resuming at prefix-offset 40
[12:01:03.315] sample: sess-1123 prefix=40 toolcall=0 suffix=0 (duplicate)
[12:01:33.500] ledger: commit sess-1123 confirmed_tokens=0 adjustment:-40 (dedupe applied)
```
ben: ledger adjustment -40 is from dedupe. provisional still shows +40 from sample until next reconciliation which flips sign?
devon: yep — and our dashboard shows provisional_delta = sample_total - committed_total. If committed_total jumps down due to dedupe we can briefly see negative provisional if sample_total was adjusted before sampling cleared stale points.
maria: customer complained because UI showed them losing credits mid-session. they saw -18 which is small but alarming.
alyssa: UX mitigation: hide negative provisional deltas for sessions younger than X seconds or show a tooltip explaining provisional is an estimate pending reconciliation.
sam: short-term: we can change dashboard to clamp provisional_delta >= 0 for the per-session line items, but keep account-level provisional as-is. longer-term we should fix sampling->reconcile ordering.
ben: is there any risk clamping hides real overcharges? i.e., provisional negative signals a refund/adjustment.
devon: negative provisional here is not refund — it's an artefact. Refunds come from confirmed ledger refunds with refund flag. This is purely an estimate churn. Clamping per-session seems safe.
maria: operational ask: add a console tooltip + clamp per-session provisional for next deploy. Also create a runbook entry for billing-alert ops so CS doesn't panic.
ops-bot: ticket created: BI-9874 "Clamp per-session provisional deltas + tooltip" assigned to @alyssa, priority P2.
alayssa: I'll do the UI change and a short blurb for the runbook. Can someone file a follow-up engineering ticket to revisit sampler/reconcile ordering?
sam: filed ENG-2038: "Sampler-reconcile ordering race causing provisional artifacts" assigned to @devon.
devon: I'll take ENG-2038. initial plan: add monotonic sampling watermark per session and introduce a reconciliation TTL before ledger adjustments update provisional visible to UI.
ben: small note — make sure any change doesn't break provisional smoothing tests. add unit + e2e for truncated toolcall + reconnect flow.
maria: thanks — ping me when the UI patch is staged so I can show the customer a safer dashboard screenshot. :thumbsup:
alayssa: pushing a draft PR with clamp + tooltip today, will post link in thread.
ben: thanks all. keeping this visible so CS/ops know it's not an actual charge bug.
sam: closing the loop once ENG-2038 has a proposal.
